The '''Kuna's Fist system''' was one of the [[Kuna systems]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. It contained the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Kuna's Fist/Legends|Kuna's Fist]] as well as several barren [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that were [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] it.

==Description==
The Kuna's Fist system was one of the [[Outer Moddell systems]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye]], [[Kuna's Horn system/Legends|Kuna's Horn]], and [[Kuna's Tail system/Legends|Kuna's Tail systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]]&ndash;type [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kuna's Fist/Legends|Kuna's Fist]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by several barren [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="TEA" /> It formed a part of the [[Kuna constellation]], as seen and named by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]], and was one of the [[Kuna systems|five systems]] of the constellation that were actually located within the Moddell sector, in relative proximity to each other.<ref name="Endor">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

==History==
Although the Kuna's Fist and Kuna's Horn systems were sparsely inhabited and rarely visited, over several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], a number of rumors and tales accumulated concerning the worlds located there. One such rumor claimed that the Ayrou had hidden treasure somewhere in the Kuna systems, and despite none of the claims being proven, the two systems offered many potential hiding spots for stubborn fortune seekers to search.<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kuna's Fist system was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
